 Try Now NEET PG Counselling 2026: Round 1 seat allotment result out; check live updates on schedule, documents required (Representative Image: Magnific) The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) announced the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test Postgraduate (NEET PG 2026) counselling round 1 seat allotment results today, October 23. As per the NEET PG seat allotment 2026, a total of 28,723 candidates have been allotted in round 1. Candidates who applied for round 1 NEET PG counselling 2026 can download the seat allotment result on the official website at mcc.nic.in

 NEET PG Companion:  Get Expert Guidance for NEET PG Admissions with One-to-One Counselling 
 MCC allots the MD and MS seats for 50% of the All India Quota (AIQ) based on candidates' choices, and the respective state authorities conduct the counselling for the remaining 50% of state quota seats. 
 MCC NEET PG seat allotment is based on various factors such as the candidate's NEET PG rank, category, reservation criteria, seat availability, and choices filled during NEET PG counselling. MCC conducts four rounds of All India Quota (AIQ) NEET PG counselling for qualified candidates: rounds 1, 2, and 3, and a stray vacancy round if seats are left vacant.
 Also read NEET PG Counselling: At private medical colleges, deemed-university tag brings up to 1,471% fee hike 
 NEET PG Counselling 2026: How to download seat allotment? 
 The steps to download MCC NEET PG counselling 2026 round 1 seat allotment results are given below. 
 Visit the official website at mcc.nic.in
 Click on the PG counselling tab. 
 A new page will appear. 
 Click on the NEET PG seat allotment result PDF.
 The PDF will open on screen.
 Find your name using Ctrl+F.
 Download and save for future reference.
 Candidates who are allotted seats must submit the required documents during the verification process. The list of required documents after seat allotment is given below. 
 NEET PG admit card
 NEET PG result
 Mark Sheets of MBBS/BDS professional examinations
 MBBS/BDS Degree Certificate
 Internship Completion Certificate
 Registration certificate issued by MCI
 Date of birth proof
 Valid ID proof
 Caste certificate
 Disability Certificate
 Candidates allotted a seat in NEET PG round 1 admission will have to report to colleges between October 26 and November 2. The data verification for candidates will be done on November 3.

 NEET PG Counselling: Guidelines for disabled candidates
 PwBD aspirants for MD/MS will be judged according to the type of their chosen medical branch – surgical, other clinical, pre-clinical or para-clinical. 
 This approach is a stark departure from the past, when all PwBD candidates – those with more than 40% disability – were assessed using blanket, percentage-based disability evaluation criteria, irrespective of their specialisation.
